title: A Star at the Farm
skill_description: Practice reading vowel + r patterns where the r changes the vowel sound: ar (star), or (horse), er (her), ir (bird), ur (turn).
author: FunBookies
summary: A girl named Fern lives on a farm where she cares for a horse, birds, and a turtle. After a storm, Fern helps the animals and finds a bright star that gives her hope.

pages.text: A Star at the Farm
pages.scene: A girl named Fern standing in a farm yard at dusk, looking up at a bright star. A barn and horse visible behind her. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Words to Know
Fern was a girl who lived on a farm. Her farm was far from the town, near a river.
pages.scene: A farmhouse with a barn near a winding river, set in green countryside. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern had a horse in the barn. The horse was short and had a dark brown coat.
pages.scene: A short brown horse standing in a red barn. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Every morning, Fern would start her day in the yard. She gave her horse corn and water from the river.
pages.scene: Fern feeding corn and water to her horse in the morning sun. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: There were birds that lived near the barn. Fern could hear them chirp in the summer air.
pages.scene: Colorful birds chirping near the red barn in summer. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Under the porch, Fern had a purple turtle. The turtle would turn and curl in her purple shell.
pages.scene: A purple turtle curled under a wooden porch. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: One day, a storm came from the north. The sky grew dark, and Fern could hear the wind howl hard.
pages.scene: Dark storm clouds gathering over the farm from the north. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern said, "I must get my horse to the barn! The storm will hurt her if I do not start now!"
pages.scene: Fern running toward her horse as the storm approaches. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern ran to the yard. She could feel the first drops of water on her shirt. The dirt turned to mud.
pages.scene: Fern running through the yard as rain begins to fall. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The horse was by the river, far from the barn. Fern ran over the hard dirt and never stopped.
pages.scene: Fern running toward her horse by the river in the rain. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern got to her horse. She said, "Turn this way! We must go to the barn where it is safe."
pages.scene: Fern guiding her horse away from the river. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: They ran together. The storm burst over the farm, but Fern and her horse were in the barn at last.
pages.scene: Fern and her horse safely inside the barn as storm rages outside. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern could hear the birds chirp under the barn roof. The turtle was safe on the porch. All were safe.
pages.scene: Birds sheltering in the barn rafters, the turtle safe under the porch. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: After the storm, Fern went to the yard. The air was cool and clean. The farm looked better after the water.
pages.scene: Fern walking in the fresh yard after the storm, everything looks clean. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The sun went down over the farm. Fern sat on the porch with her purple turtle and looked at the dark sky.
pages.scene: Fern sitting on the porch at sunset with her turtle. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern saw the first star in the north. It was bright and far away. She said, "I never saw such a star!"
pages.scene: A bright star appearing in the northern sky at dusk. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The star made Fern feel warm inside. She said, "After a hard day, there is always a star to give us hope."
pages.scene: Fern smiling up at the bright star, feeling peaceful. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern went to the barn to say goodnight to her horse. The horse was resting after the long storm. All was well.
pages.scene: Fern gently petting her horse goodnight in the barn. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern sat under the star and looked over her farm. Her bird, her turtle, and her horse were all here, safe and together.
pages.scene: Fern sitting in the yard with all her animal friends, star shining above. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: She said, "This is my farm. It is far from town, but it is where I belong. I am a girl with a star."
pages.scene: Fern standing proudly in her farm yard, star bright above. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Fern never forgot that star. Every night, she would look to the north and remember the storm and her farm.
pages.scene: Fern at her window looking at the star, peaceful night scene. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The End
pages.scene: The farm under the night sky with the bright star shining down. Warm watercolor style.
